title: WPMS/39514/1996 of RAMBIR SINGH Vs ADDL COMMISSIONER AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 39514 of 1996
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. M.S. Bhandari, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. C.S. Rawat, Chief Standing
Counsel for the State.
Instant petition was dismissed on
07.08.2008.
A Review Application No. 1320 of 2008
was filed, which was rejected in non
prosecution. A Recall Application was also
filed. In the meanwhile, the petitioner died
and his wife filed the following applications:-
CLMA No. 8027 of 2018 for
substitution, CLMA No. 8028 of 2018, Delay
Condonation Application in submission of
the Substitution Application, CLMA No.
8029 of 2018, setting aside abatement
application and CLMA No. 8030 of 2018,
Delay Condonation Application in seeking
setting aside abatement.
These applications also have history,
which has already been recorded in
previous order. But, this Court does not
intent to go further into that history. Fact
remains that today date is fixed for disposal
of these applications.
State has not filed any objection as
such. Learned Chief Standing Counsel
would very fairly concede that these
applications may be allowed and the matter
may be heard.
One of the grounds taken in the delay
condonation application or substitution
application or setting aside abatement
application is that the petitioner was totally
unaware about the filing of instant writ
petition. She had no knowledge about the
substitution and delay.
Having considered, this Court is of the
view that the delay condonation
applications, substitution application and
setting aside abatement application deserve
to be allowed. Accordingly, CLMA No. 8027

of 2018, CLMA No. 8028 of 2018, CLMA No.
8029 of 2018 and CLMA No. 8030 of 2018
are allowed. Delay in filing setting aside
abatement application and in filing
substitution application are condoned. The
abatement is set aside.
The applicant Smt. Raj Rani Singha is
substituted as petitioner. The petitioner
shall file amended memo of parties.
In this matter, as stated, after
dismissal of writ petition, a review
application was filed by the petitioner,
which was rejected in non prosecution on
16.04.2010. This order dated 16.04.2010
was subsequently recalled on an application
filed by Smt. Raj Rani Sigha. It may be
noted that till then she was not substituted.
Therefore, order dated 27.09.2018 is not in
accordance with law. The application
seeking restoration of order dated
16.04.2010 needs to be reheard.
Accordingly, order dated 27.09.2018 is
recalled.
Learned Chief Standing Counsel seeks
time to file objections on MCC No. 747 of
2018.
Let these objections be filed and
objection may also be filed on the review
application.
Since, it is a very old matter, let the
petitioner file memo of parties within two
working days. In next three days, the State
may file objection on MCC No. 747 of 2018
as well as on the review application.
List on 28.07.2022 just after fresh
cases for hearing on MCC No. 747 of 2018
and the review application, if the occasion
arises.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 19.07.2022
Jitendra
